# A01-S57: Socialist futures

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

Thanks for the recommendation. The chapter about Bogdanov is really good, and regarding the future of work the whole socialist image machinery is important. In the neoliberal paradigm, a future without work is almost an existential crisis. However, everything indicates that post-work there will be more to grasp than Marx's critic-proletariat dreams of fishing, hunting and chit-chatting.
